name: Propel Funeral Partners Limited
summary: Propel Funeral Partners Limited provides death care services in Australia and New Zealand. The company owns and operates funeral homes, cremation facilities, cemeteries, crematoria, and related infrastructure. It also engages in the collection and transfer of the deceased; provision of mortuary services; and arranging and conducting of a funeral, cremation, burial, and memorialization. The company serves individuals and families dealing with or preparing for death and bereavement. Propel Funeral Partners Limited was founded in 2011 and is based in Sydney, Australia.
